# unifi_setting_global_network (Resource)

Manages the site-wide `global_network` setting (UniFi Network 11.x), which holds the default security posture of the zone-based firewall.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unifi_setting_global_network" "this" {
  default_security_posture = "ALLOW_ALL"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_security_posture` (String) The default security posture between zones, as stored by the controller (`ALLOW_ALL` on a default UniFi Network 11.0.99 site).

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import the singleton setting of the provider configured site (the id part is ignored)
terraform import unifi_setting_global_network.this default:global_network
```
